title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(応用バイオ学科)
subtitle: Design Project III(Applied Bioscience)
keywords: Life science 2.New functional substrate 3.Biotechnology 4.Sense and action 5.Brain science
educationalGoal: In modern society, technological development based on life science is expected. In this department, students mainly learn genetic engineering, biotechnology, and brain science such as DNA or protein synthesis, basic functions of organisms and the mechanisms of the brain that controls sense and actions. We develop human resources who will be responsible for next-generation industries.
advice: Activities of Design Project III (PD III) are conducted in each laboratory. The theme of graduation research (PD III) will be determined under the supervision of the instructor. The seminar meets once per week. In the seminar, you report the results of experiments and have a discussion about the research plan.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of biology, chemistry, physics, and statistics Basic experimental techniques Safety first

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand and manipulate life phenomena at the molecular and cellular level.
Ability to perform basic operations on proteins and biomolecules.
Ability to explain human senses and actions, and overall brain functions.
Ability to take basic measurements of human and biological senses, actions and brain functions.
Ability to make presentations and reports based on logical considerations.
